lines.en: label beachwars9:
scene anotherbeachwarssceneimgoinginsane1
Someone makes it back while another struggles to find her place.
lines.zh: 有人顺利返回,另一个却还在挣扎着寻找自己的位置。

lines.en: Not just in the forest, but in a world that has been tossing and turning in an attempt to throw her off since the moment she set foot somewhere she wasn’t meant to be.
lines.zh: 不只是在林子里,而是在这样一个世界里:从她踏进本不该踏足之地的那一刻起,它就翻来覆去地想把她甩下去。

lines.en: Right now, she’s in another location just like that. And she has been dropped there by an entity that you may think you are familiar with when, in all actuality, you barely even know it.
lines.zh: 此刻,她正处在另一个那样的地方。把她丢在那里的是一个你自以为熟悉的存有——而实际上,你对它几乎一无所知。

lines.en: If you think you know what I’m talking about, you’re wrong. Because each subject in each section of each sentence I speak to you is the opposite of what you want it to be.
lines.zh: 如果你以为你知道我在说什么,那你错了。因为我说给你们听的每一句话、每一段、每一个主语,都与你们想让它成为的样子相反。

lines.en: Is that a riddle? Maybe.
lines.zh: 这是个谜语吗?也许是。

lines.en: Will it be on a quiz? Maybe.
lines.zh: 会出现在测验里吗?也许是。

lines.en: Do I even {i}want{/i} you to know?
lines.zh: 我到底想{i}不想{/i}让你们知道?

lines.en: Yes.
lines.zh: 想。

lines.en: Because while it may often seem that divine intervention is not as much {i}divine{/i} as it is simply {i}intervening,{/i} the truth to all of this is that it’s really quite simple.
lines.zh: 因为虽然看起来,神圣的干预往往并不那么{i}神圣{/i},而只是单纯的{i}干预{/i},但这一切的真相其实相当简单。

lines.en: This is a love story.
lines.zh: 这是一个爱情故事。

lines.en: And yes, there’s a lot more to it.
lines.zh: 是的,它远不止如此。

lines.en: And yes, love itself is a complicated thing.
lines.zh: 是的,爱本身就是复杂的东西。

lines.en: And yes, I’m only stalling right now because I’m desperate for someone to crawl further into the woods and every single second between what happens then and what happens {i}now{/i} is keeping {i}me{/i} safe.
lines.zh: 是的,我现在只是在拖延时间,因为我拼命想让某个人往林子更深处爬,而从{i}此刻{/i}到那时候之间的每一秒,都在保{i}我{/i}的平安。

lines.en: But it’s putting everyone else in danger.
lines.zh: 但这也把其他人全都置于危险之中。

lines.en: This world is a beautiful place.
lines.zh: 这个世界是个美丽的地方。

lines.en: And for every wire branching out from my heart, there is a wish that we’ll all come to understand that some day.
lines.zh: 从我心中伸出的每一根线,都系着一个愿望:愿我们有一天都能明白这一点。

lines.en: I word it differently every time, but I always mean the same thing.
lines.zh: 每次我的措辞都不同,但我想说的永远是同一件事。

lines.en: It’s like rearranging a prayer at night because you think you might be able to trick God into giving you what you want through the clever twisting of letters.
lines.zh: 就像在夜里把一句祈祷重新排列,因为你以为能用巧妙扭动的字母骗过上帝,让他给你想要的东西。

lines.en: Tonight, more letters will be twisted.
lines.zh: 今晚,会有更多字母被扭动。

lines.en: At my bedside and yours.
lines.zh: 在我的枕边,也在你的枕边。

lines.en: Or perhaps a bonfire full of familiar faces that will all experience hardship in the years to come if the years themselves are not the hardship in question.
lines.zh: 或者,在一堆篝火旁——围着那些熟悉的面孔;如果未来的年岁本身不是苦难,那他们也都会在往后的年岁里经历苦难。

lines.en: This is a love story.
lines.zh: 这是一个爱情故事。

lines.en: It’s a million love stories.
lines.zh: 是一百万个爱情故事。

lines.en: It’s a {i}trillion{/i} love stories.
lines.zh: 是{i}一万亿{/i}个爱情故事。

lines.en: There is love {i}everywhere{/i} we look- but we’re so desperate for enlightenment that we always try to turn it into something else.
lines.zh: 我们{i}目光所及之处{/i}皆有爱——可我们如此渴望顿悟,总是想把它变成别的东西。

lines.en: We can’t sit still.
lines.zh: 我们坐不住。

lines.en: We have to move forward.
lines.zh: 我们必须向前。

lines.en: And if our legs will not cooperate, we have no other choice but to break them.
lines.zh: 而如果双腿不肯配合,我们别无选择,只能把它们折断。

lines.en: Right now, a girl is lost in the woods.
lines.zh: 此刻,有个女孩在林中迷路了。

lines.en: And while there are a million other things she should be worrying about-
lines.zh: 虽然她本该担心的事还有一百万件——

lines.en: While there are a {i}trillion{/i} other things she should be worrying about-
lines.zh: 还有{i}一万亿{/i}件——

lines.en: What she wants is all too simple.
lines.zh: 她想要的却简单得不能再简单。

lines.en: What she wants is her mother.
lines.zh: 她想要的是她的妈妈。

lines.en: : Oh my God, no way. Did she really?
lines.zh: : 哦我的天,不会吧。她真的?

lines.en: : Yeah. Kirin ain’t always been the best at stuff like that.
lines.zh: : 是啊。Kirin 这种事一向不太在行。

lines.en: But her prayers are far too common.
lines.zh: 可她的祈祷太寻常了。

lines.en: She never learned to twist them.
lines.zh: 她从来没学会把它们扭曲。

lines.en: : Hey. Is the gravure thingy over already?
lines.zh: : 嘿。那个写真什么的已经结束了?

lines.en: scene anotherbeachwarssceneimgoinginsane2
: Oh, Ami! Took ya long enough. Just where the heck did ya drop Ayane off? Hiroshima?
lines.zh: : 哦,Ami!你可算回来了。你到底把 Ayane 丢在哪个鬼地方了?广岛?

lines.en: : I took her exactly where I was supposed to. It’s not my fault it was like a bajillion miles away.
lines.zh: : 我把她送到了该送的地方。路程远得像有十万八千里,那可不是我的错。

lines.en: : Contest is over, Ami. But if you were worried about Uta and me getting too {i}risque,{/i} you can find peace in the fact that Sensei’s bodyguards and Miss Watabe prevented us from getting too close.
lines.zh: : 比赛结束了,Ami。不过如果你担心我和 Uta 太{i}出格{/i},你可以放心:Sensei 的保镖和 Watabe 老师没让我们靠得太近。

lines.en: : I didn’t expect you guys to do that. And it wouldn’t be my place to stop you either way.
lines.zh: : 我倒没想到你们会那么做。而且不管怎样,也轮不到我来阻止你们。

lines.en: scene anotherbeachwarssceneimgoinginsane3
: Wait, what?
lines.zh: : 等等,什么?

lines.en: : Who are you and what have you done with Ami?!
lines.zh: : 你是谁,你把 Ami 怎么了?!

lines.en: : Ah! The number one spot is starting to slip away! I have to update my journal!
lines.zh: : 啊!第一名的宝座开始动摇了!我得去更新我的日记!

lines.en: : Did...something happen?
lines.zh: : 是……出什么事了吗?

lines.en: : Why is everybody being so weird?
lines.zh: : 为什么大家都这么奇怪?

lines.en: : You’re the one who’s bein’ weird! This is the part where you’re supposed to be all “Ahhhh! Sensei is my uncle and we’re gonna move to Alabama” or somethin’!
lines.zh: : 奇怪的是你吧!这时候你该大喊『啊啊啊!Sensei 是我舅舅,我们要搬到阿拉巴马去』之类的才对啊!

lines.en: scene clearnightsky
: Is that really how you guys look at me?
lines.zh: : 你们真的是这么看我的吗?

lines.en: : Isn’t that...how you {i}want{/i} us to look at you?
lines.zh: : 那不就是……你们{i}想{/i}怎么看我的方式吗?

lines.en: : Yeah! The whole time I’ve known you, it’s been “Sensei this. Sensei that.” Did you drop your incest fetish in the woods or something?
lines.zh: : 对啊!我认识你这么久,一直是『Sensei 这样』『Sensei 那样』。你把你的乱伦癖丢在林子里了吗还是怎么的?

lines.en: : Yeah, this is weird...It’s like normal Ami went into the woods and then...Ami 2 came out of it or something.
lines.zh: : 是啊,这很奇怪……就像正常的 Ami 走进了林子,然后……出来的是 Ami 二号之类的。

lines.en: scene anotherbeachwarssceneimgoinginsane4
: I promise I’m the same Ami as always. The only thing that changed is that I’m a little worried about Ayane right now...
lines.zh: : 我保证我还是那个一直没变的 Ami。唯一变的是,我现在有点担心 Ayane……

lines.en: : Hello?...Yasu?...Anyone?...
lines.zh: : 喂?……Yasu?……有人在吗?……

lines.en: : I really hope she’s able to find her way back...that forest is pretty scary in the middle of the night.
lines.zh: : 我真的希望她能找回来……那片林子半夜还是挺吓人的。

lines.en: : I’m sure she’ll be fine. If anything, we should be worried about Yasu. That girl can’t even find her way to the classroom most of the time.
lines.zh: : 她会没事的。要说担心,我们更该担心 Yasu。那女孩大多数时候连教室都找不到。

lines.en: : Yeah, and Touka’s been worried sick ever since she came back. Which, by the way, was way earlier than you, Ami. You sure you brought Ayane to the right place?
lines.zh: : 是啊,而且她回来之后 Touka 担心得要命。顺便说一句,她可比你早回来多了,Ami。你确定把 Ayane 送对地方了?

lines.en: : Hello?....Anyone?...
lines.zh: : 喂?……有人在吗?……

lines.en: : Yeah, definitely.
lines.zh: : 当然确定。

lines.en: scene anotherbeachwarssceneimgoinginsane5
: But, Ayane stuff aside...I think I owe you an apology, Chika.
lines.zh: : 不过,先不提 Ayane 的事……我觉得我欠你一个道歉,Chika。

lines.en: : You...do?
lines.zh: : 你……欠我?

lines.en: : Yeah...I was really rude when you came to the maid cafe the other day, and I wanted to let you know I didn’t mean anything bad by it.
lines.zh: : 嗯……前几天你来女仆咖啡厅的时候我真的很失礼,我想让你知道,我并没有什么恶意。

lines.en: : I’m just...not really good with change sometimes. But that’s not your fault, it’s mine. And I’m trying to get better when it comes to stuff like that.
lines.zh: : 我只是……有时候不太擅长面对变化。但那不是你的错,是我的。而在这种事情上,我正在努力变好。

lines.en: : That’s...
: That’s really cool of you, Ami...Thank you.
lines.zh: : 你真的很大度,Ami……谢谢你。

lines.en: : Doooooooes this mean you’ll come work at the cafe now? Because I can make that happen, Chika. I’m like the Yakuza boss of all things cute.
lines.zh: : 那——这——是——不——是——说你愿意来咖啡厅工作了?因为这我可以安排,Chika。我可是可爱之物的黑帮老大。

lines.en: scene anotherbeachwarssceneimgoinginsane6
: Give me a night or two to sleep on it. There’s a huge sale on swimwear next week and, at the bare minimum, I’ll have to put in my two weeks notice. I can’t bail right before things get busy.
lines.zh: : 给我一两个晚上考虑一下。下周泳装有大促销,而且至少我得提前两周递交辞呈。我不能在忙起来之前撂挑子。

lines.en: : Ahh...beautiful. This is the exact level of consideration and loyalty I look for in team members.
lines.zh: : 啊……太美好了。这正是我挑选团队成员时看重的那份体贴与忠诚。

lines.en: : Right after how cute they are in the uniform, of course.
lines.zh: : 当然,排在她们穿制服有多可爱之后。

lines.en: : Are you...really trying to change, Ami?
lines.zh: : 你……真的在试着改变吗,Ami?

lines.en: scene anotherbeachwarssceneimgoinginsane7
: Yeah. Why do you ask?
lines.zh: : 是啊。为什么这么问?

lines.en: scene anotherbeachwarssceneimgoinginsane8
: No...particular reason, I guess. I think it’s great that you’re going to give Sensei a little more breathing room.
lines.zh: : 没……什么特别的理由吧。我觉得你能给 Sensei 多一点喘息的空间,这很好。

lines.en: : I just...I’m not really sure if, like...I understand {i}how{/i} you’re trying to change. And whether or not you’re even serious about it.
lines.zh: : 我只是……不太确定,{i}怎么{/i}说……我是否理解你想怎么改变。也不确定你是不是认真的。

lines.en: : I don’t blame you for doubting me, Noriko...I just got a bit of a wake-up call the other day when Sensei told me that I’ve been suffocating him. That wasn’t ever my intention.
lines.zh: : 你怀疑我,我不怪你,Noriko……前几天 Sensei 告诉我,我一直在让他窒息,那算是给我敲了个警钟。那从来都不是我的本意。

lines.en: : He...told you that?
lines.zh: : 他……跟你这么说的?

lines.en: scene anotherbeachwarssceneimgoinginsane9
: Yeah...I’m a little ashamed to admit it, though...
lines.zh: : 嗯……不过说起来我有点惭愧……

lines.en: : This whole time, I thought I was protecting him.
lines.zh: : 这一整段时间里,我一直以为自己是在保护他。

lines.en: : After...
lines.zh: : 在那次……

lines.en: : After the...a...accident...I...
lines.zh: : 在那场……事……事故……之后,我……

lines.en: : I kind of...
lines.zh: : 我有点……

lines.en: : Well, I guess I’ve...never really been the same since then. And Sensei’s all I have now, so...
lines.zh: : 嗯,我想……从那以后我就再也不一样了。而 Sensei 是我现在唯一的依靠,所以……

lines.en: : Sensei or no Sensei...you’re not alone, Ami.
lines.zh: : 不管有没有 Sensei……你都不是一个人,Ami。

lines.en: scene anotherbeachwarssceneimgoinginsane10
: Miku?
lines.zh: : Miku?

lines.en: : That’s...all I wanted to say.
lines.zh: : 那……就是我想说的全部了。

lines.en: : I ain’t gonna be able to get the rest out.
lines.zh: : 剩下的我说不出来了。

lines.en: : Miku’s right. And if you ever need anybody to talk to about any of that stuff, I’m sure all of us would be happy to help.
lines.zh: : Miku 说得对。而且如果那些事你需要找人聊聊,我相信我们谁都乐意帮忙。

lines.en: scene anotherbeachwarssceneimgoinginsane11
: You really mean that?...
lines.zh: : 你真的愿意吗?……

lines.en: : Yeah. Right, girls?
lines.zh: : 当然。对吧,各位?

lines.en: : Heck yeah! As the self-proclaimed Yakuza boss of cute stuff, you can count on Uta-chan to have her girls’ backs! Just make sure you keep showing up to work if you wanna keep that benefit.
lines.zh: : 那还用说!作为可爱之物自封的黑帮老大,Uta 酱一定会罩着自己的姑娘们!不过想继续享受这份福利,记得准时来上班。

lines.en: if norikoblock == True:
: And I’ll...
lines.zh: : 而我也会……

lines.en: scene anotherbeachwarssceneimgoinginsane12
: I’ll...be there for you too. Yeah.
lines.zh: : 我也会……在你身边的。嗯。

lines.en: : This...this is a trauma thing. I get it. It’s not your fault.
lines.zh: : 这……这是创伤带来的。我懂。不是你的错。

lines.en: : Thank you, Noriko...
lines.zh: : 谢谢你,Noriko……

lines.en: : Do you...
: Do you still look at me as...an honorary Nakayama sister?...
lines.zh: : 你还把我当成……荣誉 Nakayama 家的姐妹吗?……

lines.en: : Yeah...
: And I’ll...I’ll help you with...
lines.zh: : 而且我会……我会帮你……

lines.en: : With anything you need...
lines.zh: : 帮你做你需要的任何事……

lines.en: : That means the world to me...
lines.zh: : 这对我意义重大……

lines.en: : Thank you.
lines.zh: : 谢谢你。

lines.en: $ norikoblock = False
scene black
else:
scene anotherbeachwarssceneimgoinginsane12
: I’ve got your back too, Ami. And I’m looking forward to whatever version of you is able to exist without keeping Sensei on an invisible leash.
lines.zh: : 我也挺你,Ami。而且我很期待那个不用把 Sensei 拴在一条隐形绳子上的你。

lines.en: scene anotherbeachwarssceneimgoinginsane13
: {i}I wouldn’t mind being kept on a leash if Sensei was the one who held it.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}如果是 Sensei 牵着绳子,被拴着我也无所谓。{/i}

lines.en: : Hey. You can at least have the courtesy of-
lines.zh: : 嘿。你至少该有点-

lines.en: : Amen. Tie me up and keep me in a cage.
lines.zh: : 阿门。把我绑起来关进笼子吧。

lines.en: scene anotherbeachwarssceneimgoinginsane14
: Hey! I said I’m trying to change! Not that I’m already done changing!
lines.zh: : 嘿!我说了我在试着改变!又没说我已经改好了!

lines.en: : I, Uta Ushibori, hereby declare that I am in favor of the leash as well! Court adjourned!
lines.zh: : 我,Uta Ushibori,在此宣布:我也赞成绳子!休庭!

lines.en: scene black
: Come on, you guys! You’re making it hard on purpose!
lines.zh: : 拜托各位!你们是故意在刁难我吧!

lines.en: And so the fire burns out and the night comes to an end...
lines.zh: 于是篝火燃尽,夜晚走到了尽头……

lines.en: A few new bonds are formed and everything ends happily ever after.
lines.zh: 几段新的羁绊结下,一切都幸福美满地收场。

lines.en: Ami gives up on pursuing a romantic relationship with her uncle.
lines.zh: Ami 放弃了与舅舅的恋情。

lines.en: Chika gets a job at the maid cafe and winds up earning enough money to take her sister somewhere nicer.
lines.zh: Chika 在女仆咖啡厅找到工作,最后赚够了钱,带妹妹去了更好的地方。

lines.en: Uta and Miku improve their grades and somehow wind up at the top of the class.
lines.zh: Uta 和 Miku 成绩进步,不知怎么还成了班上的顶尖。

lines.en: And Noriko accepts that she will never be her sister...before stealing her man and marrying him.
lines.zh: 而 Noriko 接受了『自己永远成不了她姐姐』这件事……然后抢走了她的男人,嫁给了他。

lines.en: Everything works out in the end.
lines.zh: 一切最终都圆满收场。

lines.en: scene anotherbeachwarssceneimgoinginsane15
Except it doesn’t.
lines.zh: 只是,并没有。

lines.en: You see, for every person living their best life, there are ten living their worst.
lines.zh: 你要明白,每一个过着最好生活的人背后,都有十个过着最糟生活的人。

lines.en: And if it ever feels like you’re lost in the woods with nowhere to go-
lines.zh: 而如果某天你觉得自己迷失在林中、无路可走——

lines.en: Well, you might actually be lost in the woods with nowhere to go.
lines.zh: 那么,你可能真的迷失在林中、无路可走。

lines.en: : Yasu?! Are you out here?! You are, right?!
lines.zh: : Yasu?!你在外面吗?!你一定在的,对吧?!

lines.en: You might be stuck there forever.
lines.zh: 你可能会永远困在那里。

lines.en: : Let’s go back together! I’ll give you the point and everything! I just want to go home!
lines.zh: : 我们一起回去吧!我把那一分让给你都行!我只想回家!

lines.en: You might starve to death or be mauled by bears or some other equally devastating scenario because, while “love” may be in abundance, so is danger.
lines.zh: 你可能会饿死,或者被熊撕碎,又或者遭遇某个同样毁灭性的场景,因为『爱』虽然丰盛,危险也一样丰盛。

lines.en: So is fear.
lines.zh: 恐惧也是。

lines.en: So are a million other negative emotions that we’re supposed to stave off in pursuit of three or four positive ones.
lines.zh: 还有一百万种别的负面情绪也一样丰盛,而我们为了追逐那三四样正面的情绪,本该把它们挡在门外。

lines.en: When things work out, life is amazing.
lines.zh: 当一切顺利时,人生美妙无比。

lines.en: But when they don’t?
lines.zh: 可当一切不顺呢?

lines.en: : Can {i}anyone{/i} hear me?! Anyone at all?!
lines.zh: : {i}有人{/i}听得到我吗?!不管谁都行?!

lines.en: {b}IT IS HELL{/b}
lines.zh: {b}那就是地狱{/b}

lines.en: : Yasu! Please! I know you’re out here! Just follow the sound of my-
lines.zh: : Yasu!求你了!我知道你在外面!跟着我的声-

lines.en: scene anotherbeachwarssceneimgoinginsane16
: Ya-
lines.zh: : Ya-

lines.en: scene anotherbeachwarssceneimgoinginsane17
scene anotherbeachwarssceneimgoinginsane18
: Now, what’s a beautiful girl like you doing wandering around the woods in the middle of the night?
lines.zh: : 那么,像你这样漂亮的女孩,半夜在林子里乱走是做什么呢?

lines.en: : Who...
lines.zh: : 你是谁……

lines.en: scene anotherbeachwarssceneimgoinginsane19

lines.zh: : 为什么?……

lines.en: : It must have been scary, huh? Being all alone out here.
lines.zh: : 一定很吓人吧?一个人孤零零地在这儿。

lines.en: scene anotherbeachwarssceneimgoinginsane20
: Do I...
: Do I know you from somewhere?...
lines.zh: : 我是不是在哪里见过你?……

lines.en: : I don’t know. Do you?
lines.zh: : 我不知道。你见过吗?

lines.en: : You just...
lines.zh: : 你只是……

lines.en: : I feel...
lines.zh: : 我觉得……

lines.en: scene anotherbeachwarssceneimgoinginsane21
: I’m sure you feel a lot of things. It’s hard {i}not{/i} to with so much chaos biting at your ankles.
lines.zh: : 我相信你感觉到了很多东西。这么多混乱在咬你的脚踝,很难{i}不{/i}感觉到。

lines.en: scene anotherbeachwarssceneimgoinginsane22
: But things will get better. I just know it.
lines.zh: : 但一切都会好起来的。我就是知道。

lines.en: : How...
lines.zh: : 你怎么……

lines.en: : {i}How{/i} do you know that?...
lines.zh: : 你{i}怎么{/i}会知道?……

lines.en: : I just do, okay? Are you really going to question a mysterious girl who shows up in the woods right when you need her to?
lines.zh: : 我就是知道,行吗?你真的要质疑一个恰好在你最需要的时候出现在林子里的神秘女孩吗?

lines.en: : It just...
lines.zh: : 只是……

lines.en: : It feels like this is all just a dream...
lines.zh: : 感觉这一切就像一场梦……

lines.en: scene anotherbeachwarssceneimgoinginsane23
: I sure hope not! Something like that would completely devalue both of our existences.
lines.zh: : 我当然希望不是!那种事会让我们两个人的存在都彻底贬值。

lines.en: scene anotherbeachwarssceneimgoinginsane24
: Hahah...hah...good point...
lines.zh: : 哈哈哈……哈……说得也是……

lines.en: scene anotherbeachwarssceneimgoinginsane25
: I’m Ayane...it’s nice to meet you. If this even {i}is{/i} our first meeting.
lines.zh: : 我叫 Ayane……很高兴认识你。如果这真的{i}算是{/i}我们第一次见面的话。

lines.en: : I kind of like the idea of a first meeting in the woods. Sounds like something out of a fairytale.
lines.zh: : 我挺喜欢在林中初遇这个设定的。听起来像童话里的情节。

lines.en: scene anotherbeachwarssceneimgoinginsane26
: It {i}feels{/i} like something out of a fairytale. I was beginning to think I’d be lost out here forever.
lines.zh: : {i}感觉{/i}就像童话里的情节。我都开始以为自己要永远迷失在这里了。

lines.en: : Hey, who knows? Without my help, you might have been.
lines.zh: : 嘿,谁知道呢?要是没有我帮忙,说不定你真的会。

lines.en: : You mean...you’ll help me find my way back?
lines.zh: : 你的意思是……你会帮我找回去的路?

lines.en: : Of course! That’s my job, after all. I’m like a cute, mysterious tour guide.
lines.zh: : 当然!毕竟那是我的工作。我就像一个可爱又神秘的导游。

lines.en: scene anotherbeachwarssceneimgoinginsane27
: Does this cute, mysterious tour guide have a name?
lines.zh: : 这位可爱又神秘的导游有名字吗?

lines.en: : She does. And a rather nice one at that.
lines.zh: : 有的。而且是个相当好听的名字。

lines.en: : Well, are you going to tell me? Or are you just going to keep being all {i}mysterious?{/i}
lines.zh: : 那你打算告诉我吗?还是准备一直{i}神秘{/i}下去?

lines.en: scene anotherbeachwarssceneimgoinginsane28
: It’s easier to be {i}mysterious{/i} when you don’t know what to call me.
lines.zh: : 在你不知道该怎么称呼我的时候,保持{i}神秘{/i}会容易些。

lines.en: scene anotherbeachwarssceneimgoinginsane29
: But I’m sure you’ll figure it out some day.
lines.zh: : 不过我相信总有一天你会想明白的。

lines.en: : And if you don’t, I am {i}mega{/i} screwed.
lines.zh: : 要是你想不明白,那我就惨{i}大发{/i}了。

lines.en: : Then, mysterious tour guide girl...
lines.zh: : 那么,神秘的导游小姐……

lines.en: : Yes, not-so-mysterious and stunningly beautiful blonde girl?
lines.zh: : 在呢,不那么神秘、却美得惊人的金发姑娘?

lines.en: : Can I trust you when you say things are going to get better?
lines.zh: : 你说一切都会好起来,我可以相信你吗?

lines.en: scene anotherbeachwarssceneimgoinginsane30
: Yes.
lines.zh: : 可以。

lines.en: : You’re 100%% sure?
: But keep in mind, that doesn’t mean they won’t be hard.
lines.zh: : 不过要记住,那不代表过程不会艰难。

lines.en: : That thing you’re worrying about, though? With your friend who might actually be a serial killer or whatever?
lines.zh: : 你在担心的那件事呢?关于你那个朋友——说不定是个连环杀手什么的?

lines.en: scene anotherbeachwarssceneimgoinginsane31
: How do you-
lines.zh: : 你怎么-

lines.en: : Don’t.
lines.zh: : 别问。

lines.en: : She won’t lay a finger on you.
lines.zh: : 她不会动你一根手指的。

lines.en: : What do you mean she...won’t lay a finger on me?
lines.zh: : 你说她……不会动我一根手指是什么意思?

lines.en: : Do you trust me or not? Cause if I were you, I’d take the whole “reading your mind” thing as a pretty big hint that it’s probably okay to trust me.
lines.zh: : 你到底信不信我?换作是我,光是『能读你的心』这一点,就已经是个足够大的暗示了,说明相信我大概没问题。

lines.en: : Is that how you knew about that? You can read my mind?
lines.zh: : 你就是这么知道的?你能读我的心?

lines.en: : Maybe.
lines.zh: : 也许。

lines.en: : Or maybe I just {i}already{/i} knew?
lines.zh: : 或者也许我{i}早就{/i}知道了?

lines.en: : Or maybe you {i}told{/i} me?
lines.zh: : 又或者也许是你{i}告诉{/i}我的?

lines.en: : That’s the beauty in being mysterious. I can say whatever I want to you and you’ll just have to nod and go along with it.
lines.zh: : 神秘的美妙之处就在这儿。我想对你说什么就说什么,你只能点头附和。

lines.en: : She really won’t hurt me?...
lines.zh: : 她真的不会伤害我?……

lines.en: : She really won’t hurt you.
lines.zh: : 她真的不会伤害你。

lines.en: : Is this the part where I just blindly entrust my future to a girl I met in the woods?
lines.zh: : 这就是我要把自己的未来盲目托付给一个林中偶遇的女孩的时刻吗?

lines.en: : So long as I can entrust mine to {i}you{/i} one day.
lines.zh: : 只要有一天,我也能把我的未来托付给{i}你{/i}。

lines.en: scene clearnightsky
: Now, come on! We’ve got a heck of a lot of walking to do!
lines.zh: : 好了,走吧!我们有好长一段路要走呢!

lines.en: : R-Right! Yeah!
lines.zh: : 好、好的!嗯!

lines.en: : Adventure..........begin!
lines.zh: : 冒险…………开始!

lines.en: : H-Hey! You don’t have to pull so hard!
lines.zh: : 喂、喂!你不用拉得这么用力吧!

lines.en: scene anotherbeachwarssceneimgoinginsane32
When the night comes to an end, just know-
lines.zh: 当夜晚走到尽头时,你只需知道——

lines.en: I’ll be beside you always.
lines.zh: 我会一直在你身边。

lines.en: Through rain and fog, in heat and snow-
lines.zh: 穿过雨与雾,穿过酷暑与飞雪——

lines.en: At the end of every hallway.
lines.zh: 在每一条走廊的尽头。

lines.en: scene whereareyou
scene anotherbeachwarssceneimgoinginsane33
O’er these dark, unventured hills we climb-
lines.zh: 我们翻越这些黑暗、无人涉足的山丘——

lines.en: With canisters of light.
lines.zh: 提着一罐罐的光。

lines.en: The dawning of a new day dies.
lines.zh: 新一天的黎明死去。

lines.en: scene black
And it’s here we say goodnight.
lines.zh: 而我们在此道晚安。

scene anotherbeachwarssceneimgoinginsane35
scene black

lines.zh: {i}她找到了她。{/i}
